facts.fact: 开学前夜 Millie 从精酿酒吧带回死讯。
facts.anchor: The first they heard of the dead girl was when Millie returned from the craft ale house the evening before the start of the autumn term.

facts.fact: 案发是二十年前的 1999 年千禧夜。
facts.anchor: ‘Twenty years ago. New Year’s Eve 1999. The millennium.’

facts.fact: 女孩在这套公寓的前卧室被自己的枕头闷死——正是 Olivia 的房间。
facts.anchor: ‘In this actual flat. Smothered with her pillow in her bed, in the front bedroom. Your bedroom.’

facts.fact: 官方说法是入室盗窃失手，凶手未落网。
facts.anchor: ‘A burglary gone wrong, apparently,’ Millie added, although no one had asked for details. They weren’t yet ready to hear them. ‘The killer was never caught.’

facts.fact: 消息来自 Millie 遇到的大三男生，其继兄当年在利兹。
facts.anchor: This third-year guy I met at the craft beer place told me. His stepbrother was in Leeds when it happened.

facts.fact: 对方凭"教堂对面、Spar 往下"确认就是这栋房子。
facts.anchor: He asked me where our flat was, so I went, “Opposite the church, just down from the Spar.”

facts.fact: Olivia 快速盘算：搬走可能让团体散伙。
facts.anchor: Olivia calculated quickly. If they moved out, the group might be broken up.

facts.fact: 她不挪床，只把脚朝床头睡，防的是被室友看出她也怕。
facts.anchor: Besides, moving the bed would prove to the others that she, too, had been spooked.

facts.fact: 章末点出 2004 年报道的记者名叫 Kate Marsden。
facts.anchor: The story ran under the name of the reporter, Kate Marsden.
